pull.title: KAFKA-21355: Add a fuzzer for the uniform2 assignor
pull.body:
The unit tests of the uniform2 assignor check hand traced cases, but its
properties must hold for any group and any sequence of changes.

This patch adds a fuzzer checking them on random groups and random
sequences of events: members joining and leaving, one at a time or
several, topics gaining partitions, and subscriptions changing. Other
events make the input stale, as the coordinator can pass it to the
assignor, such as topics deleted or created again while members still
hold their partitions, and empty subscriptions.

Changes:
- `Uniform2FuzzScenario` generates the groups and the events, and passes
  every group to the assignor as a group spec built with
  `GroupSpecFixture`.
- `Uniform2AssignorFuzzTest` checks validity, spread and balance,
  determinism under shuffled inputs, the fixed point with the same map
  instances, the same map for every member whose partitions do not
  change, the movement bounds after a single leave or join, and the
  moves of tiny groups, at most one above the fewest found by a brute
  force oracle.
- It also checks that the two ways of counting of the balance step give
  the same quotas, and that a run of at least 2,000 events goes through
  every kind of event.
- The default run takes seconds, and environment variables scale it up,
  see the class Javadoc.
